responsibility: This public header exposes the C/C++ intrinsic interface for the Loongson MMI multimedia extension. It defines the 64-bit vector types used by the extension and provides always-inline wrappers around the corresponding __builtin_loongson_* builtins for arithmetic, saturation, logic, shift, pack/unpack, compare, and other SIMD operations, serving as the user-facing programming interface on top of the backend patterns in loongson-mmi.md.
